description: This file contains unit tests for the HealthStore component, specifically testing the behavior of the health state when a probe failure occurs on a linked channel within the HealthSnapshot structure. It defines a test case that sets up a specific health snapshot with a failing probe and checks that the store's state transitions to degraded as expected.

methods.name: `linked channel probe failure degrades state`
methods.description: A test method verifying that the HealthStore enters a degraded state when a linked channel's probe fails.
